dedupe_keys.name: pymrio multi regional input output analysis in python

description: pymrio is an open-source Python tool for analysing global environmentally extended multi-regional input-output tables (EE MRIOs). It gives a high-level abstraction over MRIO databases, with automatic download functions and parsers for EXIOBASE 3 (and versions 1 and 2), WIOD, the OECD tables, Eora26 and GLORIA. It checks parsed tables for missing parts, calculates the standard accounts such as footprints, territorial accounts and impacts embodied in trade, and includes Ghosh calculations, search and extraction, aggregation and reclassification of regions and sectors, restructuring and characterisation of extensions, gross trade analysis, export to several formats, visualisation and automated reports. It ships a small test MRIO of six regions and eight sectors. The package is on PyPI and conda-forge (version 0.6.3, December 2025, Python 3.9 or later), licensed LGPL-3.0, with source on GitHub and documentation on Read the Docs. Caveats: it computes static accounts and does not model dynamic disruption, and results inherit the limits of the chosen MRIO. For simulation it prepares and analyses the inter-industry networks that feed supply-chain disruption and cascading-loss models. Related catalogue records include EXIOBASE, the World Input-Output Database, BoARIO and Eora2.
